# Third-party notices

Original Lytronaut code is MIT. The following upstream license/notice texts and explicit declarations
accompany the complete resolved Cargo workspace graph. Research references
in README are acknowledged but no code from those projects is bundled.
SQLite's bundled C database engine is public domain; it is a database dependency,
not an image/video processing runtime.

### UPSTREAM-LICENSE-DECLARATION.toml

```text
[package]
name = "convert_case_extras"
version = "0.2.0"
authors = ["rutrum <dave@rutrum.net>"]
edition = "2021"
description = "Extra features for convert_case"
license = "MIT"
keywords = [ "casing", "case", "string" ]
categories = [ "text-processing" ]
readme = "README.md"
repository = "https://github.com/rutrum/convert-case-extras"

[profile.release]
codegen-units = 1
lto = true
panic = 'abort'

[features]
random = ["rand"]

[dependencies]
convert_case = { version = "0.11.0" }
rand = { version = "^0.8", optional = true }
```
